scope.in_scope: Write and edit app specs (work/*.app.json), coach specs (work/*.coaches.json) and React screens (react-coach/src/screens/*.jsx)
Use the baw-dev-tools MCP tools to build, install, inspect and test apps
Install new ZZ test apps, and new snapshots of apps created in this task

out_of_scope.item: Writing or editing TWX, BPMN, XSD or coach XML. If the tools cannot express something, report it
Changing the platform code (the MCP server, generators, React runtime or shared components)
Copying screens, fields or specs from other process apps on the server
BPMN process models for import (IBM BAW Author mode), custom widgets (BAW Coach Widget mode), toolkits (BAW Package Manager mode)

safety_rules.rule: Never read or print .env, credentials or tokens. The MCP server holds them.
New apps use a "ZZ " name and an unused ZZ acronym. Never install into an app you did not create in this task.
Never put client or personal data into specs or screens. Example values are obvious samples such as 1234567890 or name@example.com.
Always use a new snapshot name for an install. Never reuse an installed snapshot name.
A step is done only when test_service reports "ok": true and you have looked at its screenshots.
